meta.layout: strict wheels-and-links geometry, positions baked; renderer must NOT compute layout. Inner ring r=140 (center EMPTY, 5 class starts), 10 wheels r=400, 12 theme wheels r=700, keystones r=970. Coords ~ -1030..1030. Graph is PLANAR: no edge crosses another (validated at generation).
meta.edge_drawing: edges listed in edge_arcs must be drawn as circular arcs around (cx,cy) with radius r (minor arc between the two nodes); all other edges are straight lines between node centers.

rules.start: character begins with ONLY its class_start node allocated
rules.allocate: a node can be allocated iff adjacent to an allocated node
rules.refund: refund allowed iff remaining allocated set stays connected to class start
rules.points: 1 point per level + quest rewards; keystones cost 1 like any node
